id: # Columns: id | shell (zsh|bash|both) | typed line ({sp} = a literal space, the cursor is at the end)
#   | assert | expect | bash32 (same | skip | expect:<alternative>, applied when the bash under test is 3.x) | notes
# Asserts: set_eq (exactly these candidates, '|'-separated; '-' = none)   set_empty   set_has   set_not
#          buf (the whole line after <TAB>, exact)   buf_unchanged   msg / msg_not (zsh only: _message text)
# Cover, per grammar row: positive, prefix, nothing before the first legal flag word, ignored-branch negative,
# already-present filter, buf without trailing space for --opt=, next-word negative for =-, dir slash +
# escaped space and a ':' name for files, set_empty past the last argument of every subcommand (zsh msg
# "no more arguments" too), set_empty + zsh msg for an argument that is not a local path.

notes: unique prefix inserts with a space
ambiguous prefix leaves the line alone
file positional (run with --cwd fixtures: dir/, 'file with space.yaml', plain, x:y.txt)

expect: CMD sub1 eu file\ with\ space.yaml{sp}

notes: ':' in a file name (bash 4+ splits COMP_WORDS there)
no flags inside a file name
zsh names the value it expects
